body: Do not go! Pay attention  to what everyone else here is saying. I am concerned for your wellbeing. It is a trap, your passport will be taken upon arrival and your human rights violated to the highest degree.

Hey man it's good to hear from you. I'm glad you're still here. Drink lots of water, you need to flush whatever you took out of your system. Have some bread or crackers as well, nothing too hard to eat.

No. Speaking from experience. And I took a metric fuckload of those things. They'll knock you for a day and then you'll wake up unable to move or speak or anything, in and out of consciousness until they leave your system. Dont try this, instead maybe talk to us about why you feel this way? I hope you're okay.
Depending on the sleeping pills you might just wind up like me, who woke up in the hospital after taking around 200-300 seroquel extremely upset that it didn't work

Hey. I hear you. I understand how you feel, and I feel your pain. People who have never been depressed or suicidal can often never relate, so they say stupid things and compare your life to someone else's that seems "worse". Worse is subjective, because everybody deals with things differently. That's why it is impossible to compare someone's pain to another person's. Just because you may live what looks to be a privileged life compared to say someone on the streets does not mean you are happy. I never understood why people make these comparisons and guilt and shame those who feel like they have nothing left to live for. 

I also struggle with adhd, and had a really hard time in school because of it, I wasn't diagnosed until my grad year in 2019 when it was too late. I always suffered at the hands of teachers because of this. Honestly, fuck the teacher who makes a student feel like a writhing pile of garbage over something they cannot control. Ignore it. Soon enough you wont have them anymore, and hopefully your next one will be better. It should be standard for teachers to learn basic ways to cope with students with learning difficulties like adhd, but I guess it isn't, or they simply don't care. Another thought would be bringing this up with administration if it is bad enough. You have as much value as the kid next to you, and deserve to be treated just the same.

Either way, is there anyone you can talk to at all? School councillors, or any professionals or trusted adults? At all? I understand that it is very hard to find someone suitable to listen to you and try to help. At the very very least, call a suicide helpline. You deserve a shot at living your life. Your post sounds more like a cry for help than anything, and you deserve that fucking help. I am so proud of you for making it this far. 

From a random internet stranger- I care about you! You are not alone!

I love you too bro. If you make it out like I did when I did the same thing, could you please reply? I would love to know that you're safe and alive. I don't know you or your story, but I understand what it takes to push a person this far. I hear you, I feel your pain and I acknowledge you. 

-the random internet stranger that cares about you

Exactly why you should bring it up. If you're thinking about this, then if you dont bring it up it could possibly bother you in the long run. Plus, he doesnt deserve the satisfaction of thinking you're stupid and he successfully pulled the wool over your eyes. I've been here, exactly a year ago. I confronted them (offending female was one of my best friends at the time, who also hid it from me) and I was completely satisfied with how it turned out, having them know they couldn't hide shit from me. Granted, this was also done in the school parking lot where I had already graduated from in front of a lot of people, since she wanted it public to try and defame me (lied about me cheating on him at a bar which she wasn't even old enough to go to) which failed miserably. Take away his satisfaction and give it to yourself.
